prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 77.1%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, redesign] Account Sync Status and Reset Recovery Banner: Redesign sign_in layout to a split screen with account restore status and sync badges so returning users know their pets will be recovered. (why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again, and sign_in conversion is 72.9%.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pre-Adoption Desktop Visibility Check: Insert a new screen before certificate issuance to verify pet desktop rendering and display resolution. (why: 3 support emails reported pets failing to show on desktop or app failing to launch, while adoption conversion drops to 60.9%.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Controls Quick Start Walkthrough: Add an interactive 3-card control walkthrough on home_intro explaining desktop pet interactions, hiding, and talking. (why: 3 support tickets highlight post-onboarding confusion regarding hiding and talking to the pet, and finish step completes at only 64.8%.)
3: [choose_path, reorder] Story Scroll Path Selector Reorder Flow: Ensure story screen acts as an immersive narrative backdrop directly feeding into path selection. (why: choose_path conversion is 77.1% with high mean time (514s), indicating users need clearer context before making their path selection.)
4: [adoption, hint] Custom Pet Creation Quality Guidelines Hint: Display explicit photo lighting and angle guidance on the upload_photos screen to improve pet model generation accuracy. (why: 3 support emails report custom pet generation failing or looking incorrect, contributing to adoption step friction.)
5: [home, wait_info] Interactive Generation Tip Carousel: Add an auto-advancing tip carousel to the waiting screen explaining pet interactions while initial generation completes. (why: The waiting step has a long median of 201s and mean of 2336s; users also report post-onboarding interaction confusion.)
6: [sign_in, notification] Sign In Connection Diagnostics Notice: Add online connection check indicator and clear retry helper on sign_in screen to prevent blank screens or stalls. (why: 2 support tickets report sign-in screen not appearing or stalling during onboarding.)
7: [choose_path, hint] Path Explorer Decision Helper: Show step time estimate and clear outcome descriptions on choose_path to guide fast decision making. (why: choose_path has a very high mean duration (514s), indicating hesitation when picking a path.)

scores.note: Strong support evidence (8 emails) for sign_in issues, but redesign requires client UI overhaul.
Adoption has high dropoff, but adding a new screen introduces extra friction.
Addresses finish step dropoff with interactive guide, though requires new UI flow.
Reorders story backdrop to reduce hesitation indicated by long mean step time.
High impact targeting largest funnel drop (adoption) via easy-to-add photo guidelines hint.
Addresses long generation wait time (201s median) by educating users while they wait.
Provides network diagnostics to resolve reported sign_in stalling issue.
Low cost hint addition addressing extreme user decision hesitation (514s mean time).
